description: Pay a Billify invoice with x402 v2 over MCP. Call it once without payment to receive the PaymentRequired (exact USDC on Base); sign it and call again with _meta["x402/payment"]. The invoice is marked paid when the facilitator settles.

invoice.description: The invoice's public token (UUID) or its Billify link (billify.org/pay/…, /invoice/…)

title: Pay invoice (x402)
